items.text: item galat hai
damage ho gaya
wrong order mila
nahi chahiye
change karna hai

items.context: Kya aap item ka status batayenge?
items.text: nahi item sahi nahi hai

items.context: Aapko kya karna hai iss order ke saath?
items.text: use replace karwana hai

items.context: Aap kya chahenge is galat delivery ke liye?
items.text: mujhe refund chahiye
mera order number 1 2 3 4 5 tha aur galat item aaya
jo product bheja gaya vo pura damage tha door ke paas
order cancel karna hai kyunki item totally wrong tha
mera address 2 3 5 B Sector 5 Chandigarh hai lekin yeh galat jagah pahucha
kya main item wapas kar sakta hu aur refund aa jayega
mera phone number 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0 hai us pe call kijiye
23 april ko order kiya tha par delivery me galti hui hai

items.context: Kya aap ne item receive kar liya hai?
items.text: item box me pura toot gaya tha aur use main use nahi kar sakta

items.context: Aapko jo product chahiye tha wo kya hai?
items.text: galat product mila mujhe laptop ki jagah mouse mila

items.context: Kya aap apna order number confirm kar sakte hain?
items.text: order number 4 5 6 7 8 9 hai mera ye galat shipment raha

items.context: Aap chahte hain ki hum kya karein?
items.text: mujhe refund chahiye ya phir naya item bhej do
mera address sahi de diya tha lekin order dusre ghar chala gaya
mera order number 9 8 7 6 5 tha jisme ki apple watch aani thi par ek broken pen bhej diya gaya hai
maine apna phone number 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0 9 diya tha par aaj tak kisi ne call nahi kiya meri problem ko leke
22 march ko order kiya tha aur mujhe chocolate order karni thi magar galat jagah lipstick bhej di gayi hai main ise accept nahi kar raha hu

items.context: Kya aap apna order detail mujhe de sakte hain?
items.text: maine 1 2 3 4 5 order kiya tha fish ke liye aur mujhe chicken mila hai ye galti sudharni hogi

items.context: Kya aap humse contact karne ki koshish ki thi?
items.text: aapke dwara bheja gaya product mera phone number 9 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 par call karne ke baad bhi replace nahi hua

items.context: Kya aap delivery address confirm karenge?
items.text: delivery boy ne mere ghar ka address galat likh diya tha jiske karan mera saman kisi aur jagah pahucha hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: wrong_or_damaged - received a wrong or damaged item
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
